purpose: Teach: 中絶/軍備/監理/邦人/略奪/強迫/クーデター/不起訴

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中絶を巡る法制度史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on the legal history of abortion.
lines.style: Warm, professional interest. Direct eye contact. Measured pace, genuine curiosity. A teacher checking in on a student's work with respect for the topic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の軍備縮小史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on postwar arms reduction history.
lines.style: Steady, clear-voiced. A brief pause before the answer, collecting thoughts. Matter-of-fact delivery. No apology in the tone, just straightforward correction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、原発の監理体制を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you chose nuclear regulatory oversight systems for your paper.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Nodding recognition. Warm but measured. The tone of someone genuinely considering what was written, not just checking boxes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海外邦人保護の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on the history of overseas national protection.
lines.style: Polite but steady correction. No defensiveness—just matter-of-fact clarity. Eyes steady. A quiet confidence in his own work despite the misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の文化財略奪を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper dealt with cultural property looting during wartime, then.
lines.style: Slight lean forward. Alert attention. A moment of genuine curiosity—meeting him partway this time. Warmer than before, recognizing a serious topic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、強迫観念に関する精神医学史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I wrote about the psychiatric history of obsessive tendencies.
lines.style: Patient clarity. The third correction, but delivered without frustration. Quiet firmness underneath. Eyes steady on the teacher. A student who trusts his own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、二十世紀のクーデター事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your focus was twentieth-century coup cases.
lines.style: A beat of pause. Reflective, almost gentle. The tone shifts—acknowledging that corrections keep coming. Still warm, but with a note of understanding something beyond the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、検察の不起訴処分判断を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My actual paper examined prosecutorial decisions on non-prosecution charges.
lines.style: Final correction delivered quietly but completely. Shoulders steady. Voice doesn't rise or fall dramatically—just absolute clarity. A small, resolute close. Brief exhale after the last word.
